body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them delivered to the USA with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing extra to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 2–4 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; every style can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost.

## Sizes in USA

US dress sizes convert by bust: US 8 is about a 36-inch bust (an Indian M). Use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) or choose free custom fit.

## What to wear in USA

The USA spans every climate, so pick by season: breathable cotton and georgette for summer weddings in Texas, Florida or California, and velvet or taffeta with a warm layer for winter weddings and Diwali in New York, New Jersey or Chicago.

## Festivals and wedding season

Indian weddings in the USA cluster in the warm months, and Diwali is celebrated at home, in temples and increasingly at work. Office Diwali parties need something festive but easy – see our [Diwali office party guide](/blog/diwali-party-outfits-for-the-office-usa-uk/). See the exact last order dates for upcoming festivals below and on our [festival calendar](/festival/).

## Delivery, duties and returns

| | |
|---|---|
| Shipping | Free express shipping with tracking |
| Delivery | 5–10 business days after dispatch |
| Dispatch | Ready sizes 2–4 working days · custom fit 5–7 working days |
| Duties & taxes | Included (DDP) – nothing to pay on delivery |
| Prices | Shown in US dollars; your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts to US dollars – no conversion needed |
| Returns | Ready sizes can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery; custom-fit pieces are remade free if we got your measurements wrong |

Full details: [international shipping](/international-shipping/) · [international returns](/international-returns/).

faq.q: How long does delivery to the USA take?
faq.a: Ready sizes are dispatched in 2–4 working days and custom-fit pieces in 5–7 working days; express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days, with tracking.

faq.q: Will I pay customs duty in the USA?
faq.a: No. We ship duties-paid (DDP), so duties and taxes are included and there is nothing to pay on delivery.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Prices are in US dollars. Your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts it to US dollars – no conversion needed.

faq.q: What if my size is not standard?
faq.a: Choose free custom fit and send your bust, waist, hip and height – we stitch the outfit to your measurements at no extra cost.
